display.purpose: Hero headline only. Bleeds to the frame's edge; never used elsewhere at this scale.

headline.purpose: Section titles. Never preceded by a kicker label.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, micro-labels. Uppercase, 0.02em tracking.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The system's one easing curve — entrance reveals, hover transitions, nav panel.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled accent CTA — booking action throughout the page.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #3C5A48; color: #F3EEE6; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 0.95em 1.7em; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #2C4436; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — map links, ghost CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #1C1114; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 0.95em 1.7em; border: 1px solid rgba(28,17,20,0.32); border-radius: 0; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: #1C1114; background: #1C1114; color: #F3EEE6; }

components.name: Price List Row
components.description: Ledger-style row with a dotted leader rule — the system's alternative to a card.
components.css: .ds-price-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.875rem; padding: 1.5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,17,20,0.16); font-family: 'Golos Text', sans-serif; } .ds-price-name { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-price-rule { flex: 1; border-bottom: 2px dotted rgba(28,17,20,0.32); transform: translateY(-0.35em); } .ds-price-value { font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Stamped Stub
components.description: Signature component: opening hours rendered as a punched ticket rather than a plain value. Used exactly twice in the system (proof strip, contacts) — do not generalize to other content.
components.css: .ds-stub { display: inline-block; border: 1px dashed currentColor; padding: 0.15em 0.55em; transform: rotate(-1.6deg); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Desktop header nav item — underline grows in from the left on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding-bottom: 2px; color: #1C1114; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: -3px; height: 2px; background: #3C5A48; transition: right 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { right: 0; }

narrative.overview:
CRAFT is proven through real work, not styled around it. The system borrows the grammar of a contemporary Russian menswear lookbook — the documentary-editorial register Saint Petersburg's own fashion export made internationally recognizable — rather than the salon-spa or barber-pole vocabulary the category defaults to. Raw, unglamorized photography; oversized cropped type; a disciplined, slightly off-kilter grid; a palette that stays almost achromatic so the one accent color reads as a decision, not a theme.

The system was chosen through Impeccable's direction-seed process and confirmed by the client over a dice-assigned alternative and two catalog challengers. Its explicit anti-references are the generic black-and-gold luxury barbershop template, barber-pole and scissors iconography, glassmorphism, decorative gradients, and same-size icon-card grids.

Density is low and confident: long stretches of quiet paper-toned space between a small number of fully committed moments. Nothing is decorated for its own sake — no shadows, no rounded corners, no gradients, no glass.
keyCharacteristics: Flat ink-on-paper throughout — zero border-radius, zero box-shadow, by invariant.
One accent color, used sparingly and always at full saturation.
Every headline, list, and stat aligns to the same shared content margin — no element sits closer to the frame edge than another.
Lists over cards: services, reviews, and hours are typographic rows with hairline rules.
Real client photography (hero, team) is duotone-graded; the gallery still awaits real shop photography.

rules.name: The One-Ink Rule
rules.body: Exactly one saturated color exists in this system. If a second accent is ever needed, desaturate it until it reads as a neutral, or don't ship it.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No section heading is ever preceded by a small tracked label above it.

rules.name: The Flat-Ink Rule
rules.body: If a component seems to need a shadow to separate from its background, change the ground color or add a hairline rule instead.

dos: Do keep the accent color confined to interactive/active moments — CTA, hover, the stub, hairline accents on focus.
Do set lists (services, reviews, hours) as typographic rows with hairline dividers before reaching for a card.
Do keep every headline, list, and stat aligned to the shared content margin.
Do duotone-grade any real photography added to the system; the gallery's six slots still await real shop photography.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated color.
Don't add border-radius, box-shadow, gradients, or backdrop blur as decoration.
Don't put a kicker/eyebrow label above a section heading, ever.
Don't reuse the stamped-stub treatment outside of opening-hours content.
